# Questline repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing; it is the shared source of repository rules. Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for checks and PR evidence.

Open the matching playbook under [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/) explicitly if skill discovery is unavailable. Keep changes scoped, preserve saved identities and server-owned state, and distinguish offline/synthetic checks from native game acceptance. Developer-doc edits must not change mod content.
